items.text: InBook1you learned about thePeriodicTable, and inparticular the elementsof Groups 1, 2 and 7. These three groups show typical properties of s-block and p-block elements and clear trends in physical and chemical properties. For example, in Group 1, the first ionisation energy decreases down the group, and in Group 7 the reactivity decreases down the group. You learned to understand simple chemical reactions of theseelementsandtheircompoundsandhowtotestforionssuchaschlorideandiodide.
